proposal: TCS graphics and alarms native on the DCS operator stations (no separate IEC HMI in the control room), one KKS tag database, GPS/PTP time sync from the DCS, TCS as its own IEC 62443 zone with a conduit to the DCS.
question: The Owner contract (SC-013) requires the power island control system to be 'integrated in' the plant DCS. IEC-ALP-REQ-001 E-02 offers a stand-alone TCS with an OPC UA gateway. The Owner will read this as a deviation. What integration can IEC offer: common operator stations, alarm management, KKS tag list, time synchronisation, IEC 62443 zones?
response: IEC offers the 'IE-Control T3 HMI integration package' at no price change: TCS graphics and alarms are rendered natively on the DCS operator stations through OPC UA (redundant), one KKS tag database exported to the DCS, time sync from the DCS master clock (PTP), TCS as its own IEC 62443 zone. The TCS controllers remain IEC hardware (proven, required for turbine protection). An IEC engineering station stays in the control room. Owner acceptance of this solution for SC-013 is needed.
subject: Turbine control system integration (exception E-02)
